objects.description: No custom types (structs, enums, typedefs, or classes) are defined in this header. The file only declares UTF-8 validation functions inside namespace solidity::util.

functions.name: solidity::util::validateUTF8
functions.description: Validates whether the given byte sequence in _input is well-formed UTF-8. Returns true if the string is valid UTF-8; returns false if invalid and writes the index of the first invalid byte to _invalidPosition. Use this overload when you need the exact position of the first error. Specific validation rules (e.g., handling of overlong sequences, invalid code points) are not documented in this header and are therefore unknown.
requirements: _invalidPosition must be a valid lvalue reference; the caller must provide storage for the position output.
If the function returns false, _invalidPosition contains the index (0-based) of the first invalid byte.
If the function returns true, the value of _invalidPosition is unspecified; the caller must not rely on it.
_input may be empty; an empty string should be considered valid UTF-8 unless implementation specifies otherwise (details not stated here).
No exception or error reporting mechanism is specified beyond the return value and _invalidPosition; callers must check the boolean result.

functions.name: solidity::util::validateUTF8
functions.description: Convenience overload that validates whether _input is well-formed UTF-8 and returns only a boolean status. Internally calls the position-reporting overload and discards the invalid position. Use when you need a simple validity check without error location. Specific validation rules are not documented here and are unknown.
requirements: Callers must check the boolean return value to determine validity.
Provides no position information; if the result is false and you need the failing index, call the overload with the size_t& parameter.
_input may be empty; behavior is expected to treat empty as valid UTF-8 unless implementation specifies otherwise (not stated here).

endpoints.name: solidity::util::validateUTF8

data_types.description: A sequence of bytes with no encoding guarantees. May contain any 8-bit values (0x00–0xFF), including embedded NULs and non-printable bytes. Suitable for testing functions that accept raw binary data or strings that may or may not be validly encoded (e.g., UTF-8 validators).
